outcome_access: PAST/THEN/LATER BEHAVIOR ONLY; NO FUTURE PRICE/63D/126D/252D RETURN OR PROFITS
multi_testing: Holm across all six registered tests even if 24w cannot be confirmed; within each test max-statistic over 16 holder vs institution/margin pairings
selected_pair_reuse_rule: For each horizon/direction choose pair from discovery based on predefined max test only; pre-identified selected pair then kept fixed in historical 2023–2024 replication, no recomputation of max to claim confirmation
shared_horizon_reverse_comparison: where both directional tests estimable, compare abs selected-pair rho with opposite-direction same pair, difference >=0.05 and year-block uncertainty; otherwise only association, no direction advantage
episode_overlap_control: Anchor T=L+2L*k phase-local, with T±L within same phase; no anchor time blocks overlap. Note stock time series remain dependent and years may be few.
calendar_only_power_check: 2018-22 259 weekly reference dates, 2023-24 103, 2025-26 95. Expected non-overlap anchor counts per horizon listed; final counts may fall on market-day window completeness filters, never increase by reanchoring after results.
stop_after_G3: If no tested (non-underpowered) recipe clears predeclared effect, valid time blocks, max permutation family correction and repeated year direction, close without running any G4; if clear, G4 exactly one frozen replication on selected qualified horizon/pair/direction.
cost_bookkeeping: not applicable to descriptive behavior-only studies; G6 remains blocked
change_control: after G2 PASS no effects/windows/thresholds/years/candidate count may change based on results; verified code errors logged with complete rerun, max one per gate
